summary: This note is a short biographical sketch of José Dominguez, a diminutive footballer known for above-average technical skill and speed. It describes his career path, which began abroad rather than in his home country, with Birmingham City in England. It then traces later spells at Sporting, Tottenham Hotspur, Kaiserslautern, and brief stints in Qatar and Brazil.
one_line: Biographical sketch of footballer José Dominguez, a small, fast, technically gifted player whose career took him from England to Germany, Qatar and Brazil.
key_facts: José Dominguez is described as a diminutive player with above-average technical skills and speed.
Dominguez started his professional football career outside his own country, in England, with Birmingham City.
After two years with Sporting, Dominguez returned to England.
Dominguez spent three years with Tottenham Hotspur in England.
Dominguez then spent three years with German club Kaiserslautern.
Dominguez had short spells in Qatar and Brazil later in his career.
